newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower despite NCD issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower despite NCD issue.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended lower on Wednesday, with liquidity in the banking system remaining loose despite the central bank's mop-up measure, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.338 percent against Tuesday's 6.437 close -- still far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper down to 6.35 percent against 6.45-6.50.
Dealers said banking system's liquidity was still loose despite Tuesday's income tax payments and the central bank's issue of T$5 billion negotiable certificates of deposit on Wednesday afternoon.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0890-0895 against 6.0785-0800.
